import json, subprocess, sys

def usec(path):
    fields = dict(p.split("=", 1) for p in open(path).read().strip().split(";"))
    return int(fields["t"], 16)

t0, t1 = usec(sys.argv[1]), usec(sys.argv[2])
out = subprocess.run(["sudo", "journalctl", "-o", "json", "--no-pager", "_SYSTEMD_UNIT=bench71584810-containerd.service"],
                     capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
with open(sys.argv[3], "w") as f:
    for line in out.splitlines():
        e = json.loads(line)
        if t0 < int(e["__REALTIME_TIMESTAMP"]) <= t1:
            f.write(e["MESSAGE"] + "\n")
